name: @neo4j-bloom/dagre
notes: MIT fork of dagrejs/dagre at 3.1.1; upstream is 3.1.3. Not used by the NVL layout-workers package, which depends on @dagrejs/dagre 3.1.1.

build_vs_buy.rationale: Upstream is MIT, newer and public; the fork adds nothing here.

prior_versions.note: MIT. This is the version used by NVL 1.2.2 layout-workers; latest 3.1.1 is a separate fork generation used by nothing in the suite. Only relevant if pinned to NVL 1.2.2, which is itself denied.
